title: Wind Rasengan
body:
Syntax: perform wind rasengan <target>

Description: A Wind Rasengan that can knock the target off balance.  Requires Wind chakra nature. Base damage: 137-161. 25% chance to inflict off balance. Unlocks at level 40. Costs 38 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 7 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
